title: Unbounded site comparison reflects bounded constructibility and Tor intervals
statement:
Let $T$ be a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme and $R$ a finite discrete commutative ring [def-pc-scheme] [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Use ordinary unbounded constant-$R$ module derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories] [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules] and the exact derived comparison $N_T=
u_T^*:D(T_{m et},R)	o D(T_{m proet},R)$ [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism]. Let $C\in D(T_{m et},R)$ be arbitrary, and let $c\le d$ and $a\le b$ be integers. Suppose $H^q(N_TC)=0$ for $q
otin[c,d]$, each $H^q(N_TC)$ is intrinsically constructible [def-weil-proetale-constructible-sheaf], and $N_TC$ has Tor amplitude in $[a,b]$, meaning that its derived tensor with every degree-zero pro-etale $R$-module sheaf has cohomology only in $[a,b]$ [def-weil-proetale-tor-amplitude] [def-sf-categorical-proetale-tor-amplitude]. Then $H^q(C)=0$ for $q
otin[c,d]$, every $H^q(C)$ is a constructible etale $R$-module sheaf [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf], and $C$ has etale Tor amplitude in $[a,b]$ [def-kun-tor-amplitude]. In particular $C$ is bounded constructible and bounded below [def-weil-pbc-bounded-derived-subcategories]. No boundedness, bounded-below condition, or constructibility is assumed on $C$ before applying this assertion. Here bounded constructibility is understood as in [def-weil-pbc-constructible-complexes].

proof.text: Let F be the canonical comparison on fixed-coefficient module sheaves. The existing exactness and full-faithfulness instances realize det-pe-classical-sheaves-modules directly in the source library. Its mapDerivedCategoryHomologyFunctorIso identifies F(H^q(C)) with H^q(D(F)(C)) for every q, without boundedness. Use IsZero.of_full_of_faithful_of_isZero and this isomorphism to reflect the assumed vanishing outside [c,d].

Fix q. Unpack the intrinsic fixed-module constructibility partition of H^q(D(F)(C)). On each stratum, finite_models_of_fixed_lisse converts local constancy and finite geometric stalks into finite constant models. This is precisely the source predicate ProEtale.IsConstructible. Apply the existing fixed-module constructible-origin theorem to obtain a constructible etale sheaf G and an isomorphism F(G) with this image cohomology sheaf.

Compose the resulting isomorphism with the inverse cohomology comparison to obtain F(G) isomorphic to F(H^q(C)). Functor.preimageIso lifts this along the fully faithful sheaf functor. IsConstructibleSheaf.of_iso transports constructibility to H^q(C). Apply isConstructibleEtaleModuleSheaf_iff_isConstructibleSheaf to obtain the precise etale predicate of the conclusion.

Use the existing source-library fixed-module theorem ProEtale.DerivedCategory.torAmplitudeIn_mapDerivedCategory_iff (HomComparison.lean), the underlying fixed-coefficient comparison used in lem-exc-comparison-tor-interval. Its forward implication reflects the assumed Tor interval directly for the arbitrary unbounded C. The proved source lemma Etale.DerivedCategory.hasTorAmplitudeIn_iff_torAmplitudeIn converts to the explicit etale homology-vanishing tests. No transport to coefficient site models, bounded flat model constructed here, or Noetherian comparison theorem is needed.

The reflected constructibility in every degree and vanishing outside the same ordered interval [c,d] are exactly isBoundedConstructible. Finally DerivedCategory.isGE_iff applied to the vanishing below c yields C.IsGE c, and the witness c proves t.plus C. Combine these with the reflected Tor bound to obtain the five conclusions.

lean.statement: theorem unbounded_finiteTor_comparison_reflection (T : Scheme.{u}) [CompactSpace T] [QuasiSeparatedSpace T] (R : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing R] [Finite R] [TopologicalSpace R] [DiscreteTopology R] (C : Etale.DerivedCategoryModule R T) (c d a b : ℤ) (_hcd : c ≤ d) (_hab : a ≤ b) (_hVanishing : ∀ q : ℤ, q < c ∨ d < q → IsZero ((_root_.DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology T) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R)) q).obj ((ProEtale.comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R) T).mapDerivedCategory.obj C))) (_hConstructible : ∀ q : ℤ, Scheme.IsConstructibleProEtaleFixedModuleSheaf T R ((_root_.DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology T) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R)) q).obj ((ProEtale.comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R) T).mapDerivedCategory.obj C))) (_hTor : ProEtale.DerivedCategory.torAmplitudeIn (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R) T a b ((ProEtale.comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R) T).mapDerivedCategory.obj C)) : (∀ q : ℤ, q < c ∨ d < q → IsZero ((_root_.DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (Sheaf T.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R)) q).obj C)) ∧ (∀ q : ℤ, Scheme.IsConstructibleEtaleModuleSheaf ((_root_.DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (Sheaf T.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R)) q).obj C)) ∧ Etale.DerivedCategory.hasTorAmplitudeIn R T a b C ∧ Etale.DerivedCategory.isBoundedConstructible R T C ∧ _root_.DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.plus C
